_what: Measured generation economics for the ML-20M profile pack. These are RECORDED MEASUREMENTS of one-time external events (API billing, token counting), not quantities recomputable from a released file — so this JSON is their canonical home, and every value carries how it was measured.
_generated_from: hand-curated from the measurement records cited per field; not auto-derived

input_tokens_per_profile.method: measured on a 5-movie test batch, fresh (uncached) input
input_tokens_per_profile.source: measured during the no-aggregate regeneration, 2026-08-18 (cost/runtime record)
input_tokens_per_profile.note: Both papers previously stated ~2,037, which has no traceable source.

output_tokens_per_profile.method: measured on the same 5-movie test batch

batch_cost_usd_projected.method: per-profile token measurement x 10,381 at the 50% Batches-API discount

batch_cost_usd_actual.method: actual spend on the no-aggregate regeneration
batch_cost_usd_actual.source: actual spend on the no-aggregate regeneration, 2026-08-18

sync_cost_usd.method: same token measurement without the batch discount

system_prompt_tokens.method: measured with the provider's count_tokens endpoint
system_prompt_tokens.source: measured with the provider's count_tokens endpoint (corrected from an earlier ~1,328 estimate)

min_cacheable_prefix_tokens.note: System prompt is below this, so the cache_control marker never creates an entry.

cache_read_tokens_observed.method: measured cache_read_input_tokens summed across all requests

live_verification_2026_09_02._what: A 5-movie live batch run through the RELEASED batch_generate.py, to test whether the shipped code reproduces the reported economics. Independent of the April 2026 run: different day, current SDK, prices read from the bill.

cache_read_input_tokens.note: Confirms the min-cacheable-prefix finding live: the cache_control marker is accepted and creates nothing, because the 1,389-token system prompt is below Claude Haiku 4.5's 4,096-token minimum.

live_verification_2026_09_02.verdict: The released batch path reproduces the reported cost and the caching finding.
